scenes.setting: Shaman King Klarman's Book of Secrets described — mysticism enough to make an expert of anyone; Klein asks for a day, swears secrecy on Rosago's Notary Certificate under Sharron's seal of light, and steps off the zombie-driven carriage
scenes.text_anchor: “I promise I won't tell anyone what I just learned from Miss Sharron and Mr. Maric.”

scenes.setting: Decoy divinations downstairs, the real ones at 4 a.m. above the fog (Dark Emperor card politely flipped face-down): accept, considerable but survivable danger — 'Then, let's have a grand performance.'
scenes.text_anchor: Then, let's have a grand performance.

scenes.setting: Nine o'clock, an empty living room: Klein accepts aloud to the oriel window and asks for preparation days; a bodiless voice answers 'Okay. After you've finished preparing, you can pay the bar a visit.'
scenes.text_anchor: “After you've finished preparing, you can pay the bar a visit.”

scenes.setting: Glaint's study: a Psychology Alchemists-adjacent gathering is on for this afternoon in North Borough; Glaint tags along, proud owner of the Apothecary formula — sold to him by Fors at a tidy 70-pound markup
